title: Affine algebraic groups in characteristic zero are smooth
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero [def-weil-field], and let $H$ be an affine group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme] of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Then the structure morphism $H\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. No connectedness or reducedness hypothesis is imposed.
